verdict.rationale: TrueLayer is API-first, and its core product flows are documented as API operations: payments, payouts, mandates/VRP, verification, data access, and provider queries, with SDKs and an MCP server on top. However, several Console (UI) functions have no evidenced API equivalent. These include configuring the webhook URI per app, inviting team users, generating reports, viewing balance reports and configuring sweeping. missing for 10: evidence of API access to Console admin functions (webhook configuration, user/team management, reporting, sweeping setup), a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and an explicit API-UI parity statement.
